messages:
lucy: opened PR with model-card updates for Helios-Text-2 (docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1623). Goals: clarify supported variants, update 'limits' table, add example JS+Python snippets for streaming + batch, and link new benchmarks. Need review + help adding migration note for SDK v3.

omar: nice. quick ask: can we also add a short paragraph about fallback behavior when Dedicated doesn't have Helios-Text-2 capacity? lots of customers ask.

lucy: yep adding note: "requests routed to Helios-Text-2-lite (quantized) when full variant unavailable; fallback preserves logits but may change latency/quality tradeoffs. See fallback policy section."

neal: nit on wording in 'supported variants' — call out explicit suffixes (e.g., "-full", "-lite-q4") to prevent confusion. Also add a matrix row for sequence_limit and recommended shard counts.

tara: on benchmarks: we measured throughput on V100 and A10G. Suggest we include a short sentence: 'benchmarks measured with avg prompt length 64 tokens; batching measured at 1/8/32'. Link to run: https://bench.redwood/runs/helios-1623.

omar: for quantized note: our internal q4/no-kv-cache builds drop throughput ~22% at batch=32 on A10G — we should say "~20-25%" so it's conservative. Also add a pointer to tuning guide.

lucy: adding that. also need the snippets: python streaming + js batch_embeddings. Drafting here: 
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
# streaming generate with model helm
for chunk in c.generate.stream(model='helios-text-2-full', prompt='Summarize user logs'):
    print(chunk.text, end='')
```
```javascript
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'
const client = new Redwood()
await client.embeddings.create({model: 'helios-embed-2', input: ['a','b','c'], batch_size: 8})
```

neal: looks good, small tweak on JS snippet: use 'batchSize' camelCase to match SDK v3. Also add comment about 'max_tokens_per_item' when batching.

tara: I updated the YAML card limits in the PR to show recommended replica/shard counts for common qps levels. I added an example config for Dedicated autoscale.

lucy: site-bot preview?

site-bot: preview deployed  https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.io/docs/model-cards/helios-text-2 (status: success) :white_check_mark:

omar: I found one broken link: /docs/guides/fallback-policy -> currently 404. Replaced with /docs/ops/fallbacks in the PR.

lucy: thanks, updated. Also adding migration blurb: "SDK v3: batch parameter names changed (batch_size -> batchSize), streaming API now returns async iterable. See migration guide link."

neal: approved from docs perspective. Omar, Tara any final calls?

omar: approve. small ask: include a one-liner in changelog about quantized perf delta and recommended tuning knobs.

tara: approve, added changelog entry.

lucy: merging in 10 if no objections.

lucy: merged. changelog: 'Helios-Text-2 model card: clarified supported variants, updated limits & bench rows, added SDK v3 snippets (JS/Python), migration tips, and fallback note.'

site-bot: prod sync complete  docs updated at /model-cards/helios-text-2 :rocket:
